title.narrative: Products and services from research and statistics in the region have strengthened the ILO's position as a global centre of excellence

description.narrative: Research and statistics in the region play a central role in advancing the ILO’s social justice agenda and reinforcing its position as a global centre of excellence. The Asia-Pacific Employment and Social Outlook 2026 and related knowledge products provide timely, high-quality analysis of labour market trends, supporting evidence-based policy discussions across the region. The ILO strengthens countries’ capacities to produce, report and use labour statistics in line with the latest international standards, including those on work relationships, informality and SDG indicators, while enhancing labour market information systems through improved use of administrative and innovative data sources. At the same time, the Office delivers cross-cutting, policy-oriented research and fosters partnerships with international organizations and academic institutions to address emerging decent work challenges. Through targeted training, knowledge-sharing and policy dialogue, constituents are better equipped to design, implement and evaluate inclusive labour market policies, thereby contributing to measurable progress towards decent work and sustainable development
